title: Exneium and Deaths VR Buddy-Pack
description:
This modpack is meant for one of my friends so we can play our favorite PC modpack, on VR.
This modpack is also meant for first-time modded* MCVR users
body: This modpack is something me and a friend use, and it's for VR, of course people don't have to play this in VR and can play it on PC but the main idea of the modpack is to be used in VR use as well as to have fun exploring the world.
